    // One level of Catmull-Clark subdivision. The new position array is the moved
    // old vertices, then one point per undirected edge, then one centroid per
    // face; every new face is a quadrilateral.
    CatmullClarkSubdivided(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
    {
        var faces = self.PolygonCornerFaces;
        var destinations = self.PolygonCornerDestinations;
        var twins = PolygonCornerTwins(self.Faces.Values, destinations);
        var edges = PolygonCornerEdges(twins);
        var edgeCount = PolygonEdgeCount(twins);
        var vertexCount = self.VertexCount;
        var moved = vertexCount.MapRange(v => self.CatmullClarkVertexPoint(faces, destinations, v));
        var inserted = self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => c).Reduce(Repeat(0, Point3D.Origin), (acc, c) =>
            NamesItsEdge(twins, c)
                ? acc.Append(self.CatmullClarkEdgePoint(faces, destinations, twins, c))
                : acc);
        return PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            moved.Concatenate(inserted).Concatenate(self.FaceCentroids),
            self.FaceCount.MapRange(f => f).FlatMap(f =>
                self.FaceArity(f).MapRange(s =>
                    self.CatmullClarkCornerFace(edges, vertexCount, edgeCount, f, s))));
    }
